CFML Language Reference: Functions

XMLFormat

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns a copy of a string with the characters that have a special meaning in XML replaced by entity references.

Category

String functions

Syntax

XMLFormat(string)

Parameters

string
The string to escape.

Returns

The escaped string: < becomes &lt;, > becomes &gt;, & becomes &amp;, " becomes &quot; and ' becomes &apos;.

Usage

Use XMLFormat when you build XML by hand, for example a channel file for a portal site. CFWDDX does its own escaping. For HTML pages use HTMLEditFormat, because older browsers do not know &apos;.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Title = "Tom & Jerry's <Greatest> Hits">
<CFSET Xml = "<item><title>" & XMLFormat(Title) & "</title></item>">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Original: #HTMLEditFormat(Title)#</P>
<P>XML: <TT>#HTMLEditFormat(Xml)#</TT></P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

HTMLEditFormat, CFWDDX, JSStringFormat, URLEncodedFormat
